# AI Document Summarizer MVP

## 🎯 Commercial Job Reference & Budget
- **Platform Reference:** Malt (Mission Freelance: *Analyseur et Synthétiseur IA de Documents Techniques & Juridiques*)
- **Target Budget Range:** €2,500 - €5,000
- **Average Freelance TJM:** ~700€ / jour

---

## ⚡ Performance Features & Architecture
- **Chunked Text Scanning:** Processes long legal and technical documents by breaking paragraphs into memory-friendly chunks.
- **Pre-Compiled Pattern Matching:** Key clause extraction uses global regex pattern indices compiled once at module load.
- **O(1) Summary Metric Benchmarks:** Computes compression ratios and scanning metrics instantly.

---

## 🚀 How to Run
Open `index.html` in any web browser or deploy as a static webapp.
